lesson.summary:
Past perfect dibentuk dengan *had + V3* untuk semua subjek: *I had left, she had finished*. Bentuk ini dipakai ketika kita sedang bercerita tentang masa lalu dan ingin menunjukkan bahwa sesuatu sudah terjadi lebih dulu sebelum titik itu.

Contohnya *When we got to the station, the train had already left.* Keretanya berangkat dulu, baru kami tiba. Bandingkan dengan *When we got to the station, the train left*, yang berarti kami tiba dan setelah itu keretanya berangkat.

Past perfect adalah "masa lalu dari masa lalu". Bandingkan dengan present perfect yang berpatokan pada sekarang: *I'm not hungry. I've just eaten* (sekarang). *I wasn't hungry. I'd just eaten* (saat itu).

Past perfect juga dipakai untuk pengalaman sampai suatu titik di masa lalu: *I had never eaten durian before I came to Medan.*

patterns.example: When we arrived, the film had started.

examples.en: When we got to the station, the train had already left.
examples.id: Waktu kami sampai di stasiun, keretanya sudah berangkat.

examples.en: I didn't recognise Tono. He had changed a lot.
examples.id: Saya tidak mengenali Tono. Dia sudah banyak berubah.

examples.en: She wasn't hungry because she'd just had lunch.
examples.id: Dia tidak lapar karena baru saja makan siang.

examples.en: I had never eaten durian before I came to Medan.
examples.id: Saya belum pernah makan durian sebelum datang ke Medan.

examples.en: When I arrived at the party, most of the guests had gone home.
examples.id: Waktu saya tiba di pesta, kebanyakan tamu sudah pulang.

examples.en: Had you met her before the meeting?
examples.id: Apakah kamu sudah pernah bertemu dia sebelum rapat itu?

commonMistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the meeting has already started.
commonMistakes.right: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
commonMistakes.why: Patokannya masa lalu (*arrived*), jadi pakai *had*, bukan *has*.

questions.sentence: When we got to the station, the train {{1}}.
questions.explanation: Keretanya berangkat sebelum kami tiba: had already left.

questions.sentence: I didn't recognise Tono. He {{1}} a lot.
questions.explanation: Perubahannya terjadi sebelum saya bertemu dia: had changed.

questions.sentence: She wasn't hungry because she {{1}} lunch.
questions.explanation: Patokannya masa lalu (wasn't): had just had.

questions.sentence: I {{1}} durian before I came to Medan.
questions.explanation: Pengalaman sampai titik di masa lalu: had never eaten.

questions.sentence: When I arrived at the party, most of the guests {{1}} home.
questions.explanation: Mereka pulang sebelum saya tiba: had gone.

questions.sentence: The film {{1}} when we got to the cinema.
questions.explanation: Filmnya mulai sebelum kami tiba: had already started.
Pertanyaan past perfect: Had + subjek + V3.

questions.instruction: Tulis bentuk past perfect (simple atau continuous).
questions.sentence: We were tired because we {{1}} for hours.
questions.explanation: Penyebab di masa lalu: had walked (atau had been walking).

questions.hint: Saya sudah mengunci pintu sebelum pergi.
questions.explanation: had + V3 + before + past simple.

questions.hint: Dia belum pernah naik pesawat sebelumnya.
questions.explanation: had never + V3.

questions.hint: Waktu kami sampai, filmnya sudah mulai.
questions.explanation: When + past simple, … had already + V3.

questions.hint: Apakah kamu sudah makan sebelum datang?
questions.explanation: Had + subjek + V3 + before …?

questions.sentence: When I got home, I found that someone ___ into the house.

options.why: Benar. Pembobolannya terjadi sebelum saya pulang.
Patokannya masa lalu (got, found), jadi pakai had.

questions.explanation: Terjadi lebih dulu dari kejadian lampau lain: had + V3.

questions.sentence: I ___ the book, so I knew the ending of the film.

options.why: Benar. Membaca bukunya terjadi sebelum menonton film.
Patokannya masa lalu (knew), jadi pakai had.
was reading berarti sedang membaca, tidak menjelaskan kenapa saya sudah tahu akhir ceritanya.

questions.explanation: had + V3 untuk sesuatu yang selesai lebih dulu.

questions.sentence: When Ani called, I ___ to bed yet, so I answered the phone.

options.why: Benar. Saat Ani menelepon, saya belum tidur.
Patokannya masa lalu (called), jadi pakai hadn't.

questions.explanation: hadn't + V3 … yet: belum (pada saat itu).

questions.instruction: Kalimat mana yang berarti Rina sudah pergi sebelum saya datang?

options.why: Ini berarti Rina pergi setelah saya datang.

options.text: When I arrived, Rina had left.
options.why: Benar. had left = sudah pergi lebih dulu.

options.text: When I arrived, Rina was leaving.
options.why: Ini berarti Rina sedang bersiap pergi saat saya datang.

questions.explanation: Past perfect menunjukkan urutan: kejadian itu lebih dulu.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
questions.explanation: Patokannya masa lalu: had already started.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.explanation: Setelah had perlu V3: forgotten.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: I wasn't hungry because I had already eaten.
questions.explanation: Patokannya masa lalu (wasn't): had already eaten.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: They had gone home before the rain started.
questions.explanation: V3 dari go: gone.
